text: Sometimes the doctor is in a visit and asks you to mark a result reviewed. Scout lets you, and records who and why.
Remember: only mark a result reviewed when a vet has told you to, and pick the reason that says how.
Dr. Lane called about Juniper Rivera's results. Open them.
Scout asks why. The reason is saved with your name and the time.
Dr. Lane reviewed it on the phone, so Vet reviewed verbally.
Or Vet asked me to send it to the client. Anything else, pick Other and type it.
It leaves To review. Open it under All recent,
and your name and the reason are on the result.
The most common mistake: marking results reviewed to clear the list. Remember: only mark a result reviewed when a vet has told you to, and pick the reason that says how.
